items.headline: Best-Positioned Stocks as EV and Self-Driving Tech Accelerate
items.snippet: Albemarle appears well-positioned to benefit as EV demand grows globally, projecting 10-20% CAGR for lithium demand from 2025 to 2030.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Lithium demand is up 45% through May, primarily driven by continued strength in stationary storage. We are increasing our 2026 and 2030 stationary storage forecast ranges. Lithium demand growth continues to outstrip supply growth.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation's ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on ALB stock amid softer EV demand in China, elevated inventory levels and expected supply from mine restarts.

items.headline: [US Feature Stocks] Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle (ALB), the world's largest lithium supplier, reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership on the final day of negotiation talks ahead of a strike; the proposal must be ratified through a member vote.

items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: Chinese EV sales fell 13% in 1H 2026 after subsidy withdrawals, yet global lithium consumption jumped 45% through May, above Albemarle's 15%-to-40% forecast range. Stationary storage is driving the gap.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
